title: 第10章  军中传说，林毅的威名！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
林毅心中微动，趁势说道：“爸，爷爷，既然你们也觉得我适合部队，那我还是想回去，我要回部队当兵。”
话音刚落，餐桌上刚刚缓和的气氛，骤然冰封。
林国栋脸上那抹难得的笑意快速敛去，他的脸色一点点沉下来。
他看着林毅，面色铁青：“你还要回部队？你是不是觉得，我和你爷爷这张老脸，丢得还不够彻底？”
林毅看着父亲骤然转阴的脸色，叹了口气。
得，白高兴一场。
果然，只要一提回部队，家里这两尊大佛立马翻脸。
就在气氛僵持之际，一旁的林建军缓缓开口，语气平静，听不出喜怒：“小毅，你打算回学校复读，是吧？”
林毅抬头看向爷爷，有些诧异：“爷爷，你都知道了？”
他今天才刚办完复读手续，全程就没知会过家里。
王秀兰叹了口气，轻声解释：“烟城一中的校长，是你爷爷的老朋友了，你今天一去学校，人家就打电话过来告知了。”
林毅恍然点头。
怪不得家里今天态度怪怪的，原来早就把他的底摸得一干二净。
此刻，林国栋死死盯着林毅，字字铿锵：“你小子别以为我们老糊涂了，看不透你的小心思！”
“复读、考本科，你打得什么算盘？不就是想拿到本科学历，卡着征兵年龄和学历标准，想方设法再次入伍吗？”
林毅心口一紧，没说话。
他本来也没想瞒，一开始就准备今晚吃饭的时候就把事情摊开来说。
反正他之前已经说过了，他这次肯定是要回部队的。
既然这两尊大佛不让走后门，那他就靠着自己的努力呗。
看着他沉默默认的样子，林国栋火气彻底上来了，语气不留半点余地：“我今天把话给你撂在这里！就算你真考上本科，就算你各项条件全部达标，只要我不同意，你就别想踏入军营半步！我有的是办法卡死你！”

林毅看着态度坚决、油盐不进的父亲，长长叹了口气：“算了，跟你们说不明白，我不饿，你们吃吧。”
他现在是半点胃口都没了，干脆拍拍屁股起身，溜溜达达回了自己房间。
房门一关，林毅直接四仰八叉躺倒在床上，盯着天花板发呆。
说真的，他也挺无奈的。
他当然知道，六年军旅生涯，三进三出，直接创造了军中的一个传说。
别说装甲一连了，别的部队也都流传着他的传说呢。
谁都觉得他纯属闲得慌，没事回部队折腾玩，妥妥的军中刺头，更是把老爸跟爷爷的脸面按在地上摩擦。
搞不好，这两尊大佛还以为自己是在报复呢，报复当年他俩不顾自己反对，就把自己送去部队了。
但说实话，起初的时候林毅确实想过要报复，可后来吧，他就想开了。
无所吊谓，反正总有一天能出去，总有一天老爸跟爷爷会想开的。
只要等自己出去了，还不是天高任我飞！
可谁让他退伍当天觉醒了系统，而系统要求还是必须要回部队才能激活呢。
他妈的，但凡系统早一天觉醒，他都不至于折腾这么一大圈。
现在倒好，老爸跟爷爷直接断了他的路，眼下复读这条路也被堵死了……
躺了没几分钟，脑子里乱七八糟的思绪纷飞，林毅翻身爬起来，打算冲一组俯卧撑清清脑子。
就在这时，房门被轻轻推开。
老妈王秀兰端着满满一碗饭菜进来了，菜色都是他爱吃的，还冒着温热的热气，放在书桌上。
看着自家儿子一脸郁郁寡欢的样子，王秀兰心里很是心疼，轻声开口：“儿子，别怨你爸，也别怪你爷爷。”
“你这六年三进三出，你是潇洒随性，来去自由，可他俩的脸早就被你在老战友圈子里败光了。”
王秀兰叹了口气：“外人表面打趣，说老林家出了个奇才，当兵都能三进三出，背地里谁不是看笑话？都私下议论你性子太野、不稳定，管不住、留不住。”

“你爸和你爷爷一辈子在部队堂堂正正，最看重脸面口碑，活了大半辈子没被人戳过脊梁骨，到老了反倒被你这小子折腾得抬不起头。”
林毅摸了摸鼻子，心里门儿清，他摊摊手：“妈，我知道我爸跟爷爷不容易，也知道外面闲话多，但我这次真的是想回部队，不是一时脑子发热，我是必须得回去！”
王秀兰看着他眼底那股拗到底的倔劲，就知道劝不动。
这儿子从小主意正，认定的事八头牛都拉不回来。
她无奈叹了口气：“行吧，你长大了，有自己的想法，妈不拦你，你想怎么闯就怎么闯。”
“就是以后做事别太由着性子，多体谅体谅你爸和你爷爷的难处。”
林毅咧嘴一笑，吊儿郎当点头，“放心吧，妈，我心里有数。”
王秀兰没再多说，叮嘱他趁热吃饭，轻轻带上门离开。
房间彻底安静下来。
林毅看着桌上的热饭，也没心思吃，靠在桌边暗自琢磨，越想越头大。
他爸刚才那番狠话真不是随口吓唬人。
林家在部队深耕这么多年，人脉资历摆在那里，真要卡他一个普通征兵名额，简直易如反掌。
当初他一次次想彻底退伍，结果老爷子和老爸动动关系，直接给他续上合同，硬生生把他在部队拴了六年。
能强行留他，自然也能彻底堵死他。
就算他复读考上本科，走普通大学生征兵，只要他爸点头拦一手，他百分百没戏。
普通路子彻底走进了死胡同。
林毅挠着头来回踱步，腹黑的脑子飞速转圈，盘算着各种破局的法子。
忽然，他眼睛一亮，嘴角勾起狡黠的笑。
考军校！
普通征兵归地方和武装部管，人情水分大，他家能插手。

但军校不一样啊！
全国统一考试、统一划线、公开录取、择优招生，流程透明公正，实打实的国家选拔渠道。
别说他爸是大校级别的军官，他爷爷是少将级别的军官，就算级别再高，哪怕是上将，也没资格插手军校招生的规矩吧！
只要他能考上军校，直接自带军籍、编入体制，毕业就是军官，顺理成章的重回军营，谁也拦不住他！
这次是，真天王老子来了都没用！
content_en:
Lin Yi's heart moved slightly, and he took advantage of the situation and said: "Dad, Grandpa, since you also think that I am suitable for the army, then I still want to go back. I want to return to the army and serve as a soldier."
As soon as he finished speaking, the atmosphere at the dinner table that had just relaxed suddenly froze.
The rare smile on Lin Guodong's face quickly disappeared, and his expression darkened little by little.
He looked at Ji Yi with a livid face: "You want to go back to the army? Do you think your grandfather and I haven't been completely shamed enough?"
Ji Yi looked at his father's expression that suddenly turned gloomy and sighed.
Yes, you are happy for nothing.
Sure enough, as soon as he mentioned returning to the army, the two giant Buddhas at home immediately turned against each other.
Just when the atmosphere was at a stalemate, Lin Jianjun on the side spoke slowly, his tone was calm, and there was no hint of anger or anger: "Xiao Yi, you plan to go back to school to repeat your studies, right?"
Ji Yi looked up at his grandfather, a little surprised: "Grandpa, do you know everything?"
He just completed the re-study procedures today, and he didn't even contact his family during the whole process.
Wang Xiulan sighed and explained softly: "The principal of Yancheng No. 1 Middle School is an old friend of your grandfather. As soon as you went to school today, he called to inform you."
Ji Yi suddenly nodded.
No wonder his family had a weird attitude today. It turned out that he had already found out all about him.
At this moment, Lin Guodong stared at Lin Yi and said loudly: "You kid, don't think that we are too old and stupid to see through your little thoughts!"
"What are your plans for repeating studies and taking the undergraduate examination? Don't you just want to get a bachelor's degree, and try to find ways to enlist in the army again based on the age and academic standards for conscription?"
Lin Yi's heart tightened and he said nothing.
He didn't want to hide it at all, and planned to talk about it during dinner tonight.
Anyway, he has said before that he will definitely return to the army this time.
Since these two giant Buddhas are not allowed to go through the back door, he can rely on his own efforts.
Seeing his silent acquiescence, Lin Guodong became completely angry and said without leaving any room for error: "I'm going to leave you here today! Even if you are admitted to the undergraduate program, even if you meet all the conditions, as long as I don't agree, you can't even think about stepping into the military camp! I have many ways to kill you!"
Ji Yi looked at his father who was resolute and refused to eat anything, and sighed: "Forget it, I can't explain to you, I'm not hungry, you can just eat."
He had lost all appetite now, so he simply patted his butt and got up, strolling back to his room.
As soon as the door closed, Ji Yi lay down on the bed and stared at the ceiling in a daze.
To be honest, he was quite helpless.
Of course he knew that during his six-year military career, he had entered and exited three times, which directly created a legend in the military.
Not to mention the Armored Company, his legend is also spread among other units.
Everyone thought that he was just idle and had nothing to do. He went back to the army to play, stabbed his head properly in the army, and even rubbed the faces of his father and grandfather on the ground.
Maybe, these two giant Buddhas thought they were taking revenge for sending themselves to the army despite their objections.
But to be honest, Ji Yi did think about revenge at first, but later, he thought about it.
It doesn't matter, I will be able to go out one day anyway, and my dad and grandpa will think of it one day.
As long as I get out, the sky is high and I can fly!
But who told him to awaken the system on the day he was discharged from the army, but the system still required that he must return to the army to activate it.
Damn it, if the system had awakened one day earlier, he wouldn't have gone through such a big hoop.
It's good now that his father and grandfather have directly cut off his path, and now his path to re-reading is also blocked...
After lying down for a few minutes, thoughts were swirling in his mind. Ji Yi turned over and got up, intending to clear his mind by doing a set of push-ups.
At this moment, the door was gently pushed open.
Mom Wang Xiulan came in with a full bowl of food. The dishes were all his favorites and they were still warm.of heat and put it on the desk.
Seeing her son's depressed look, Wang Xiulan felt very distressed and said softly: "Son, don't blame your dad, and don't blame your grandpa."
"You have been in and out three times in the past six years. You are free and easy, coming and going freely, but their faces have long been ruined by you in the circle of old comrades."
Wang Xiulan sighed: "Outsiders are joking on the surface, saying that there is a genius in the old Lin family, who can be in and out of the army three times. Who is not laughing behind their backs? They all talk privately that you are too wild and unstable, and you can't control or keep him."
"Your father and your grandfather have been upright in the army all their lives. They value face and reputation the most. They have lived for most of their lives without anyone poking their backs. However, when they are old, they are tortured by you and can't hold their heads up."
Lin Yi touched his nose and felt clear. He spread his hands and said, "Mom, I know it's not easy for my dad and grandpa, and I know there's a lot of gossip outside, but I really want to go back to the army this time. I'm not just crazy. I have to go back!"
Wang Xiulan looked at the stubbornness in his eyes and knew that he couldn't be persuaded.
This son has been right since he was a child, and even eight cows can't get him back from what he believes in.
She sighed helplessly: "Okay, you have grown up and have your own ideas. Mom won't stop you, you can do whatever you want."
"Just don't be too free-spirited in doing things in the future, and be more considerate and considerate of your dad and grandpa's difficulties."
Ji Yi grinned and nodded carelessly, "Don't worry, Mom, I know what's going on."
Wang Xiulan didn't say anything more, told him to eat while it was hot, then gently closed the door and left.
The room fell completely silent.
Ji Yi looked at the hot rice on the table and had no intention of eating it. He leaned on the table and thought about it secretly, and his head was getting bigger and bigger.
His father's harsh words just now were really not meant to scare people casually.
The Lin family has been involved in the army for so many years, and with all their connections and qualifications, it would be easy for him to get an ordinary recruitment spot.
At first, he wanted to retire completely, but the old man and his father had a relationship and directly renewed his contract, forcibly tying him to the army for six years.
If you can force him to stay, you can naturally block him completely.
Even if he repeats his studies and gets admitted to the undergraduate program and joins the military recruitment process as an ordinary college student, as long as his father nods and stops him, there is absolutely no chance for him.
The ordinary path leads to a dead end.
Ji Yi scratched his head and paced back and forth, his dark mind spinning rapidly, thinking of various ways to break the situation.
Suddenly, his eyes lit up and a sly smile appeared on his lips.
Take the military academy exam!
Ordinary conscription is under the control of local governments and the armed forces, and there is a lot of human support, so his family can intervene.
But military schools are different!
National unified examinations, unified delineation, open admissions, merit-based admissions, transparent and fair processes, and solid national selection channels.
Not to mention that his father is an officer at the level of a senior colonel, and his grandfather is an officer at the level of major general. No matter how high the rank is, even a general, he has no right to interfere with the rules of military school admissions!
As long as he can be admitted to the military academy, bring his own military status, be incorporated into the system, graduate as an officer, and return to the military camp as a matter of course, no one can stop him!
This time, it’s useless even if the real king comes!
